body.x: 10km.ai (CEO Elton Kim) participated in CES 2025, held in Las Vegas, USA, from January 7 to 10 (local time).

Specializing in AI-powered corporate video production platforms, 10km.ai automates the entire video production process, from creation to editing and distribution, while reflecting a company's brand identity. The company is the first in the generative AI field to be selected for Deep Tech TIPS (Tech Incubator Program for Startups).

The company's flagship solution, '10kM,' is a mobile app that transforms text-based documents into professional-grade videos within one minute. This solution automates document analysis, reference video identification, and template generation, reducing pre-production time from one day to just one minute. Its CSS animation-based HTML content also allows real-time editing of all video elements. Hybrid rendering technology between client and server enhances the efficiency of high-quality video production.
Protected by four registered patents and eight pending applications, 10kM makes professional video creation accessible to all.

At CES 2025, 10km.ai showcased its cutting-edge technology and earned an Innovation Award in the 'Mobile Devices, Accessories & Apps' category. The company highlighted its patented document-to-video auto-generation system and AI-powered editing platform for the award. Key innovations include the Gen&Edit model, which integrates foundational models, and the Plug&Show engine, which leverages edge computing to reduce video production time from 72 hours to just 5 minutes.

The solution has been validated through partnerships with over 15 companies, including Samsung Life, KT, and CJ-ENM. Notable achievements include producing 20-language safety education videos for Samsung Heavy Industries and visualizing sales condition sheets for KT.

At CES 2025, 10km.ai also introduced ‘GemGem,’ a solution that generates real-time videos from text, handwritten notes, and uploaded images. The booth attracted numerous global corporate representatives who experienced the technology firsthand. This exposure led to technical validation, investment proposals, and new opportunities.

A 10km.ai representative stated, "We aim to use CES as a launchpad for accelerating global market entry. We will focus on expanding into key markets such as the United States, Japan, and China to set a new global AI video market standard.”
AVING News, which has covered CES for 20 consecutive years, continues to support the global ambitions of Korean SMEs and startups through various initiatives.

Before CES 2025, AVING hosted a series of Global Media Meetups featuring aspiring SMEs in Korea. The Meetups introduced Korean SMEs’ technologies, products, and services to media worldwide, expanding connections between the Korean industry and global media. Geekspin, Ubergizmo, Interesting Engineering, and Le Café du Geek participated in these meetups.
During CES 2025, AVING established the AVING Broadcasting Zone at The Venetian Hotel in Las Vegas, interviewing CES Innovation Award 2025 winners.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host a review conference with participating companies in Korea, offering them a platform to gain further recognition and enhance their corporate image.
